title: Tooling
commonInfo:
## Tooling Fundamentals

### Automation First

- Automate formatting, linting, and type-checking — machines should argue about style, not humans.
- Hook critical checks into the git lifecycle (pre-commit, pre-push) to prevent bad code from entering the repository.
- Treat CI/CD pipelines as the ultimate source of truth for code quality.

### Tool Configuration

- Keep tool configuration centralized and version-controlled.
- Rely on recommended rule sets from tool authors before customizing heavily.
- Document any deviations from standard rules (e.g., why a specific ESLint rule is turned off globally).

### Developer Experience (DX)

- Fast feedback loops are critical — configure tools to run incrementally where possible.
- Ensure local tooling matches CI tooling exactly to avoid "it works on my machine" issues.
- Provide clear error messages and fix instructions when tooling blocks a developer action.
